title: Reranking a food app's home page
summary: Personalise a list of restaurants within a page load, and keep it working when the model cannot.
context: Mavalli Meals wants the home page ordered for each person: their usual lunch, what is open and near, and what is new. It has about 500 candidate restaurants at any address, and the page must appear in under 300 ms.
Availability changes by the minute, and ordering only by past clicks would keep showing the same five places. Restaurants watch their position closely and complain when it moves without reason.
must_handle: The page appears within 300 ms, whatever the model is doing.
A closed restaurant never appears at the top.
New restaurants get a fair chance to be seen.
A brand new user sees something sensible.
A model change can be compared with the current one on real orders.
show_in_answer: How candidates are gathered and then ranked for one request.
Which features come from where, and how fresh each is.
What is served when the model is slow.
How you measure beyond clicks, and how new places get shown.
